title: Module Review Quiz: Object-Oriented Programming (CPP_201 to CPP_208)

slides.title: Object-Oriented Programming Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers OOP fundamentals in C++: Classes, Objects, Access Specifiers, Constructors, Destructors, Encapsulation, Operator Overloading, and Friend functions (CPP_201 to CPP_208).

slides.title: Class Declaration (CPP_201)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to define a custom data type containing data members and functions in C++.

slides.title: Default Access Specifier (CPP_202)
slides.prompt: What is the default access specifier for members inside a C++ 'class' if none is specified?

slides.title: Public Access Specifier (CPP_202)
slides.prompt: Fill in the access modifier keyword that allows class members to be accessed from outside the class.

slides.title: Constructors (CPP_203)
slides.prompt: Which statement correctly describes a Constructor in C++?
options: A special member function with the same name as the class that initializes objects and has no return type
A static function used to delete class objects
A normal function that returns a void type
A function that must be called explicitly using dot operator
slides.correctAnswer: A special member function with the same name as the class that initializes objects and has no return type

slides.title: Destructor Syntax (CPP_204)
slides.prompt: Fill in the symbol placed before the class name to declare a Destructor.

slides.title: Encapsulation (CPP_205)
slides.prompt: How is Encapsulation primarily achieved in Object-Oriented Programming?
options: By hiding private data members behind public getter and setter methods
By deriving child classes from parent classes
By overloading function names with different parameters
By allocating object instances dynamically on heap
slides.correctAnswer: By hiding private data members behind public getter and setter methods

slides.title: This Pointer (CPP_206)
slides.prompt: Fill in the implicit keyword pointer that holds the memory address of the current calling object.

slides.title: Copy Constructor (CPP_203)
slides.prompt: Which parameter signature is required for a standard Copy Constructor of class 'Box'?

slides.title: Friend Function (CPP_207)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to grant a non-member function access to private members of a class.

slides.title: Operator Overloading (CPP_208)
slides.prompt: Which keyword is used to overload built-in operators (like +, -, ==) for custom classes?

slides.title: Operator Overloading Syntax (CPP_208)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword to define an addition operator overload method.

slides.title: Static Class Members (CPP_206)
slides.prompt: How are 'static' data members shared among object instances of a class?
options: Single shared instance exists across all objects of the class
Each object gets its own separate copy of the static member
Static members can only be accessed inside constructors
They are re-created every time a new object is instantiated
slides.correctAnswer: Single shared instance exists across all objects of the class

slides.title: Const Member Functions (CPP_205)
slides.prompt: What restriction applies to a member function declared as 'void display() const;'?
options: It cannot modify any member variables of the calling object
It cannot be called by const objects
It can only access static members
slides.correctAnswer: It cannot modify any member variables of the calling object
